description:
JOB SUMMARY 

Works closely with Manufacturing Managers, Product, Process and Manufacturing Engineers, Automation Leadership, and suppliers.  Strives to ensure that Automated Manufacturing processes are developed and implemented to support all plant performance objectives.  

Under general supervision, plans, coordinates, and oversees engineering projects and assignments. Evaluates project progress, analyzes results, and recommends improvements to equipment, processes, and procedures. Applies comprehensive knowledge of robotics and robotic programming to work with Automation team responsible for automation controls, engineering, manufacturing, and electrical systems, including Monoshell robotic applications.

 ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS 

• Analyzes engineering proposals, process requirements, and related technical data pertaining to robotic machinery and equipment design.
• Maintains and improves existing robotic machinery and automation equipment.
• Determines the feasibility of designing new robotic equipment and systems by evaluating costs, available space, time limitations, company planning, and other technical and economic factors.
• Manages the installation, operation, maintenance, and programming of robotic equipment and robotic controls in Monoshell, including Monoshell programming.
• Provides technical information concerning manufacturing and processing techniques, material properties, process advantages, and limitations affecting long-range plant and product engineering plans.
• Directs the operation, installation, and service of robotic equipment and systems, including safety requirements and coordination of outside contractors.
 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 

• Designs and develops robotic programs and applications within the facility.
• Develops, trains, and supervises development of employees learning robotic controls and programming.
• Interprets company policies to employees and ensures compliance with applicable safety regulations.
• Analyzes and resolves work-related problems or assists employees in identifying and implementing solutions.
• Tests newly installed robotic equipment and systems to ensure proper operation and fulfillment of applicable specifications.
• Performs equipment, robotic system, and project design.
• Plans, coordinates, and supervises project work.
• Performs project cost estimating and evaluates project requirements.
• Troubleshoots robotic equipment, automation systems, and related controls.
• Initiates purchases for robotic equipment, automation components, and maintenance supplies.
• Maintains, troubleshoots, and programs automated robotic and PLC systems.
• Creates electrical designs, including electrical prints and documentation for existing and new automated equipment.
• Reports maintenance, robotics, and engineering activities and project progress to management.
• Supports safety-related training as required.
 WORK ENVIRONMENT 

• Primarily works in an air-conditioned environment, with occasional exposure to noise, oil, dust, fumes, chemicals, heat, or cold.
• Requires the use of safety glasses, earplugs, metatarsal safety shoes, and other department-specific personal protective equipment (PPE).
• May require working in manufacturing areas and around operating robotic equipment and automated machinery.

 
  
  
  
 
 

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 
  
 • Minimum of 10 years of experience in automation, robotics, or related engineering disciplines. 
 • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 
 • This position is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), which requires U.S. person status. ITAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident (Green Card holder), political asylee, or refugee. 
  
  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Automation or a related engineering discipline 
 • Proficiency in AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, PLC programming, Motoman robotic programming, and Microsoft Office applications. 
 • Experience in robotic programming, robotic controls, Monoshell systems, and automated manufacturing equipment. 
 • Strong project management skills and mechanical and electrical aptitude. 
 • Excellent interpersonal and people-management skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with groups of employees, contractors, suppliers, and outside agencies. 
 • Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 • Good understanding of financial data, project budgets, and cost analysis. 
 
   

 Compensation and Benefits: 

 If a pay range is identified for this job, it is based on a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Actual compensation is subject to variation due to factors such as education, experience, skillset, market/business considerations, and/or location. 

 Howmet Aerospace offers a competitive benefits package to support the health, financial well-being, and professional growth of our employees. Benefits include: 

 

 
 Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision benefits coverage, including FSA and HSA account options 

 Pre-tax and Roth 401(k) retirement savings plans offering employer matching funds and a separate employer retirement contribution 

 Paid holidays and vacation time (eligibility, accrual, and usage are discretionary and governed by applicable policies)

 Paid parental leave and adoption assistance programs 

 Life insurance and disability coverage plans 

 Optional coverage plans for auto, home, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance 

 Tuition Assistance Program and ongoing professional development opportunities 

 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 

 
 Our Story: 

 Howmet Aerospace Inc. (NYSE: HWM), headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. Our primary businesses focus on jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems, titanium structural parts and forged wheels. With $8.3 Billion in revenue in 2025, our products play a crucial role in enabling fuel efficiency and lightweighting, contributing to our customers’ success and making a positive impact on the world. To learn more about the way Howmet Aerospace Inc. is advancing the sustainability of our customers, markets, and communities where we operate, review the 2025 Environmental Social and Governance report at www.howmet.com/esg-report . Follow: LinkedIn , Twitter , Instagram , Facebook , and YouTube .

 Equal Opportunity Employer: 

 Howmet is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

 If you need assistance to complete your application due to a disability, please email:  TalentAcquisitionCoE_Howmet@howmet.com
